A.notes: A has a clear, quiet idea built from doors, ironwork and rooflines, and it carries that mood consistently from hero to footer. Typography is confident and well spaced, and the room facts are easy to parse on desktop and mobile. The scroll-strip suggests mostly simple section reveals rather than story-driven motion, but the measured checks are excellent and the page feels very polished.

B.notes: B has a stronger sense of arrival at dusk and a memorable skyline silhouette, so the core idea is compelling and distinctive. But the execution is uneven: contrast fails the hard gate, and the page shows large empty stretches and weaker clarity around the rooms in some captures, especially on mobile/full-page views. The scroll-strip shows content progressing by section, but I cannot confirm anything more sophisticated than standard reveals from stills alone.

raw.why: A is the more complete and dependable interpretation of the brief, with stronger clarity, cleaner craft, and no hard-gate failures.
